Wordcraft is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; the MIT notice is retained in `wordcraft-LICENSE-MIT`. No Wordcraft engine implementation, brand graphics or bundled fonts are included here.

The CN1 application wrapper and Maven/IDE helper files under `app` were generated by the Codename One Maven archetype. Existing notices in those files remain intact. Codename One and other Maven dependencies retain their respective licenses; they are not relicensed by this project. Dependency/runtime distribution notices must be audited before a packaged public release.

A license for this new project's original source has not yet been selected.
